decisions.reason: Its continued standalone presentation through 2024 suggests performance at or near aspiration levels for a close-to-core offering, so management would likely retain it while uncertainty remains limited.
As a premium carpet that fits the firm's craftsmanship and materials strengths and still has its own page in 2024, it likely remains acceptable despite possibly narrower demand than simpler lines.
The move from a dedicated page in 2023 to only a website mention in 2024 signals results below aspiration or lower strategic priority, making this the strongest candidate for resource reallocation.
This product stayed fully presented on the website in 2024 and is close to the established assortment, indicating no strong performance shortfall that would trigger dropping it.
A multi-model chair line with continued standalone visibility fits the firm's established seating and project business well, so boundedly rational management would be inclined to keep it.
